name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-10-02, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.73 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
